sourceChecks.text: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI1:3で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: fact source was referenced but source object/passage/evidence row was missing; 1KI1:4 uses “the young lady” for the immediately preceding Abishag and states that she served the king, who did not know her intimately.

sourceChecks.text: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI1:15で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI2:17で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI2:21で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI2:22で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。
